subject: MAP onramp: security roadmap and data-retention clarifications
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@orangetech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Turner <bob.turner@orangetech.com>
Date: Sun, 20 May 2028 12:10:00 -0400
Subject: MAP kickoff — SOC 2/SIG/DPA scope + retention questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're drafting the mutual action plan for our payments pilot and need to lock a few security items so our procurement and legal teams can sign off. High level asks below — can your team confirm the responses and whether any of these will affect the proposed go/no-go timeline (target pilot launch: 2028-07-01)?

1) SOC 2 scope: we need a short one-page matrix that lists what services are in-scope for the SOC 2 report you will reference during the pilot (auth, inference runtime, logging, analytics). Also please state the audit period.

2) SIG/CAIQ: we want a completed CAIQ export that maps controls to your SOC 2 and any compensating controls. A CSV or export is fine.

3) DPA redlines: legal is asking for a current DPA we can review; note they will request EU residency commitments for certain datasets.

4) Data retention: for the pilot we plan to send anonymized production-like data. Need confirmation of default retention windows, delete/erase options, and whether retention can be shortened to 90 days for this pilot. Also, any logs retained longer than 90 days must be described.

If you can share the SOC 2 scope XLSX, the DPA, and a CAIQ export, I can get these to our procurement and legal immediately.

Appreciate it —
Alice
Alice Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
OrangeTech Payments

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@orangetech.com>
Cc: Bob Turner <bob.turner@orangetech.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC 2/SIG/DPA scope + retention questions

Alice — thanks for the clear list. Attaching initial artifacts and proposing a short MAP milestone schedule so legal and procurement have dates to work toward. See attachments: SOC2_scope_matrix.xlsx, Redwood_DPA_v2.1.pdf, CAIQ_answers_2028-05.csv (attached).

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: the in-scope services for our SOC 2 Type II (audit period Jan 1, 2027 — Dec 31, 2027) are: Identity/Auth, Inference API (hosted runtime), Data Storage for inputs/outputs, and Observability/Logging. The attached matrix maps each control to service components.
- CAIQ: attached CSV maps control-level responses; where CAIQ points to SOC 2, we reference the relevant section in the matrix.
- DPA: Redwood_DPA_v2.1 is our baseline. We can accept an EU data residency addendum for the pilot workload; that'll require a quick configuration change and an addendum sign-off.
- Retention: default data retention for inference inputs/outputs is 365 days with an option to configure down to 90 days for pilot customers. Audit logs are retained for 13 months by default; shortened retention for logs is possible for pilot with operational trade-offs to traceability.

Proposed MAP milestones (suggested):
- 2028-05-22: Redwood provides artifacts (done, see attachments) and proposed DPA addendum language for EU residency.
- 2028-05-26: OrangeTech feedback on DPA redlines + retention window confirmation.
- 2028-06-02: Security acceptance checklist sign-off (SOC 2 scope + CAIQ questions closed).
- 2028-06-15: Production-like data ingress (pilot staging) with retention set to 90 days.
- 2028-07-01: Pilot go-live (conditional on security acceptance).

If that timeline works, I will loop in Irene from our security team to run the CAIQ/Q&A session and Marcus to coordinate the DPA addendum.

Best,
Karthik Iyer | Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP kickoff — SOC 2/SIG/DPA scope + retention questions

Folks — forwarding OrangeTech's ask. Attachments already uploaded to the deal record. Can you confirm:
- Marcus: DPA addendum template for EU residency (can we support region-specific residency for inputs/outputs for pilot? any infra lead time?)
- Irene: Can you review the CAIQ export and confirm items that will need follow-up (particularly encryption in transit vs at rest, and logs retention trade-offs).

I put preliminary timeline in the email — they'd like sign-off by 2028-06-02.

Thanks —
Karthik

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@orangetech.com>, Bob Turner <bob.turner@orangetech.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 15:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC 2/SIG/DPA scope + retention questions

Thanks Karthik / Alice — reviewed the CAIQ export and SOC 2 matrix. High-level notes for the MAP/security acceptance checklist:

1) Encryption: Inference inputs are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Keys are customer-segregated on Dedicated/Private deployments; for hosted we offer KMS integration and rotated keys; attached CAIQ points to relevant SOC controls. No follow-up required unless OrangeTech requires HSM-backed key custody (possible via Private deployment addendum).

2) Retention: We can set the inference-input retention to 90 days for the pilot. Audit logs retention default is 13 months; we can create a filtered export and truncated view for OrangeTech for procurement purposes, but full logs will remain in our audit store unless they sign the limited-retention addendum. Note this will reduce forensic traceability for the pilot.

3) EU residency: Marcus, we'll need a config change to pin data to eu-west-1 and an addendum to the DPA; engineering lead time ~5 business days after addendum sign-off.

4) Evidence: I can provide the SOC 2 control sections mapping and redacted evidence pointers (Syslog samples, monitoring runbooks) by 2028-05-30.

5) Outstanding CAIQ items: a few control responses marked 'partial' that require a quick Q&A; propose a 30-minute call on 2028-05-24 to walk through.

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus to confirm DPA addendum language and estimated lead time (reply by 2028-05-24).
- OrangeTech to confirm acceptance of 90-day retention for inference inputs by 2028-05-26.
- Karthik to book CAIQ Q&A (2028-05-24).

Irene Choi
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@orangetech.com>
Cc: Bob Turner <bob.turner@orangetech.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC 2/SIG/DPA scope + retention questions

Alice — great, thanks everyone for the fast turn. To keep the MAP clean, I'm summarizing the decisions and asks so procurement/legal can act:

Decisions:
- Redwood provided SOC2_scope_matrix.xlsx, CAIQ_answers_2028-05.csv, and baseline DPA (Redwood_DPA_v2.1.pdf).
- Redwood confirms pilot-level inference-data retention can be configured to 90 days. Audit logs default 13 months; limited-retention addendum available if required (operational trade-offs noted).
- EU residency addendum required to pin data to eu-west-1; engineering lead time ~5 business days after addendum sign-off.

Open asks for OrangeTech (requested by 2028-05-26):
1) Legal to provide DPA redline or confirmation they accept Redwood_DPA_v2.1 + EU residency addendum language. Please attach the redlined PDF.
2) Procurement to confirm acceptance of 90-day retention for inputs/outputs for pilot.
3) Confirm attendees and time for the CAIQ Q&A on 2028-05-24 (Irene will run it).

I'll update the HubSpot deal with the artifacts and the MAP timeline (HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/87654). If you confirm the asks above, we should be able to hit the 2028-06-02 security acceptance checkpoint.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer | Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
